|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jedha: Jedha City (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-D-jedhajedhacity_ai-2021-02-19.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-jedhajedhacity_ai83cacba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jedhajedhacity_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 commit 83cacba] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jedhajedhacity_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Spaceport Prefect’s Office”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Baze, Chirrut, and Saw deploy -1 here. '''Dark Side:''' May be deployed instead of Alderaan by Set Your Course For Alderaan.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jedha: Jedha City (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''First published 15 January 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/jedhajedhacity_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/17b52a9d067da2342f96b495fd63482ea55b8dcd commit 17b52a9]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 15 January 2022<ref name="img-jedhajedhacity_ai793bf65">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jedhajedhacity_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 commit 793bf65] (15 January 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jedhajedhacity_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Baze, Chirrut, and Saw deploy -1 here. '''Dark Side:''' May be deployed instead of Alderaan by Set Your Course For Alderaan.” This image was first published on 15 January 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/jedhajedhacity_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/17b52a9d067da2342f96b495fd63482ea55b8dcd commit 17b52a9]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
